mapper.select: SELECT '及格人数' AS `name`, COUNT(CASE WHEN score >= #{passScore} THEN 1 END) AS `value` FROM t_grade WHERE term = #{term} UNION ALL SELECT '不及格人数' AS `name`, COUNT(CASE WHEN score < #{passScore} THEN 1 END) AS `value` FROM t_grade WHERE term = #{term}
SELECT s.name, FORMAT(AVG(g.score), 2) AS `value` FROM t_grade g LEFT JOIN t_subject s ON g.subject_id = s.id WHERE g.term = #{term} GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY `value` DESC
